thread:
lia (PM): quick check — proposing a compact visibility surface for the next sprint. goal: ship a small, high-leverage set we can stabilize quickly:
- 3 dashboard templates (cost-by-route, latency P95 + error rate, queuing/backpressure heatmap)
- lightweight trace hooks that are cheap by default + higher sampling on hot routes
- per-route cost breakdown prototype in console (token + infra split)
- searchable error analytics (stack trace + recent occurrences)

I want this scoped so we can roll to a subset of customers for validation. Asking for: perf/overhead constraints, minimal acceptance criteria, and owners. Please thumb/flag ASAP. :eyes:

ash (eng): thumbs. a couple clarifying q's: what do we mean by "cheap by default" for traces? 0.1%? need to align on default sampling and how customers opt-in higher sampling. also storage retention targets?

lia (PM): good q. my proposal: default trace samp 0.05 (5 per 10k), promote to 50% for hot routes only. retention: traces 7d for GA, metrics 30d. rationale: keep cost predictable and limit infra. open to SRE feedback.

kevin (SRE): 7d traces ok for GA as long as we have quick export hooks to owner buckets. need alert if trace ingestion spikes > 2x baseline for 10m. we'll add a throttle/fallback path. also recommend we instrument sampling config as a feature flag so we can change rates without deploy.

ash (eng): agree on feature flag for sampling. for trace hooks: minimal API patch is two lines inserted in request pipeline, example config: 
```
trace_sampling:
  default: 0.05
  hot_routes:
    - path: "/api/v1/generate"
      sample: 0.5
```
we should ship with SDK helper and server middleware so customers can add route-level overrides.

mike (data): for per-route cost prototype I'll need route tagging in logs (route_name + model_id) and token count. sample query for dashboard panel: 
```sql
SELECT route_name, SUM(tokens) as total_tokens, SUM(infra_cost) as gpu_cost FROM events WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY route_name ORDER BY gpu_cost DESC LIMIT 25;
```
if we standardize that schema we can wire cost-by-route quickly.

dina (eng-prod): acceptance criteria suggestion: 
- dashboards: deployable template + one infra-backed example customer + docs page
- traces: end-to-end observed latency overhead < 2% at 10k rps with default sampling
- cost breakdown: per-route view in console with token + infra split, queryable for last 7/30 days
- error analytics: search by message + stack id, show top 5 fingerprints in last 24h

lia (PM): +1 to those acceptance bullets. small addition: must have rollout guardrails (canary to 5% orgs, automatic rollback on ingestion spike). owners: ash -> trace hooks, mike -> cost proto + dashboard queries, dina -> dashboards + docs, kevin -> rollout guardrails and SRE runbook. I'll manage customer invites for the canary.

ash (eng): timeline ask: can we get a dev PR for trace SDK + middleware by EOD Wed, small spike for sampling infra by Thu? engineers up for it: @ash, @dina.

kevin (SRE): I'll add the ingestion spike alert and a circuit-breaker plan in ops runbook. also we should include throttling behavior in the SDK doc.

lia (PM): risks: cost overruns, noise from high-cardinality traces, and customers misconfiguring sampling. mitigations: default low sampling, quota-based ingestion, and a guided config UI.

observability-bot: new epic created: VIS-compact-surface, link: https://redwood.internal/epics/VIS-compact-surface (epic owner: lia).

mike (data): one more UX note — the per-route cost widget should surface the top contributing models and a toggle to show token-only vs total infra cost. that helps customers decide quantization/route-splitting.

dina (eng-prod): can we also include a short e2e test matrix in PR? e.g., simulate 10k rps with default sampling -> verify overhead < 2%; inject route spike -> ensure circuit-breaker triggers. i'll add test owners.

lia (PM): perfect. action items: 
- ash: PR for trace SDK + middleware (due Wed EOD)
- mike: first-pass cost queries + dashboard panel (due Fri)
- dina: dashboard template + e2e test matrix (due next Tue)
- kevin: alerts + rollout guardrails (due Fri)
- lia: canary org list + customer comms (due Thu)

please react with :thumbsup: when you accept your action. i'll follow up with a short deck for exec sync if everything looks on track. thanks! :rocket:
